newsitem.title: GERMANY: Fatal German asylum centre fire caused by heater.
newsitem.headline: Fatal German asylum centre fire caused by heater.

text.p: A fire that killed three young Yugoslav children in an asylum seekers' hostel in western Germany last week was caused by textiles draped over a heater, police said on Monday.
About 40 refugees, mostly from former Yugoslavia, escaped unhurt from the fire in the town of Monheim.
The children, aged three years, two years and three months, were found dead after the fire was put out. All were members of an ethnic Albanian family from the Kosovo region of Serbia.
In the past, refugee centres in Germany have been fire-bombed by far-right extremists but police said last week there were no indications that the Monheim fire had been started deliberately.
